description: This file defines the LDAPSyncService class which handles LDAP synchronization operations, including fetching LDAP users, creating/updating corresponding system users, and maintaining LDAP connection settings within an OrangeHRM PHP project.

classes.name: LDAPSyncService
classes.description: Main service class for synchronizing LDAP users with the system, managing LDAP connections, fetching entries, creating/updating users, and handling errors during LDAP sync process.

methods.name: getLDAPDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAPService with proper binding credentials.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Fetches LDAP configuration settings, throwing an exception if not configured.

methods.name: fetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Retrieves all LDAP users from search results, grouping duplicates, and returns a LDAPUserCollection.

methods.name: createSystemUsers
methods.description: Creates or updates system user accounts based on provided LDAPUser array, managing user and employee details.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Main method to synchronize LDAP users with system users, encapsulating entire LDAP fetch and user creation/update process within a transaction.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entries for all configured lookups, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: prepareLDAPUserFromEntry
methods.description: Transforms LDAP entry data into LDAPUser DTO, handling attribute extraction and validation.

methods.name: trySaveEmployee
methods.description: Attempts to save employee data; dispatches event if successful, logs error if LDAPSyncException occurs.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists employee data after validating unique email and employee ID.
